title: Detailed Query
setup:
insert into currency values (100, 'EUR', 0.85, '2022-01-01 13:29');
insert into currency values (100, 'EUR', 0.79, '2022-01-08 13:29');

positive.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(u.name, 'not defined') AS name,
       COALESCE(u.lastname, 'not defined') AS lastname,
       r.name AS currency_name,
       b.money * r.rate_to_usd AS currency_in_usd
FROM balance b
LEFT JOIN "user" u ON u.id = b.user_id
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT c.name, c.rate_to_usd
    FROM currency c
    WHERE c.id = b.currency_id
    ORDER BY (c.updated > b.updated), ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (c.updated - b.updated)))
    LIMIT 1
) r ON true
ORDER BY name DESC, lastname, currency_name, currency_in_usd;
